candidateMeaning: Given an exact 2-digit by 1-digit division, choose whether the quotient starts in the tens or ones place.
Given an exact 2-digit by 1-digit division, choose the quotient digit count from the leading-digit relation.
Given an exact 3-digit by 1-digit division, choose whether the quotient starts in the hundreds or tens place.
Given an exact 3-digit by 1-digit division, choose the quotient digit count from the hundreds-digit relation.

optionalSupportingBoundary.reason: The Path1 matrix marks quotient-zero cases optional; the P1-07 mastery gate requires only the two place-value primary KPs and quotient_start_place_cases. V1 must not silently promote the optional KP into a required primary family.
optionalSupportingBoundary.implementationConstraint: Primary P1-07 local generator candidates should avoid quotient-zero items unless a later separately approved extension explicitly admits the optional supporting KP.

boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-06: P1-06 owns two-digit-divisor estimation/trial-quotient strategy; P1-07 must not add estimation semantics.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-08: P1-07 owns quotient-start-place / quotient-digit-count semantics. Current P1-07 V1 runtime stays on one-digit divisors; two-digit-divisor quotient-place exam items are representation evidence only until separately approved. P1-08 owns full two-digit-divisor arithmetic execution/practice.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-11: P1-11 owns remainder/checking emphasis; P1-07 V1 remains exact division and does not interpret remainders.
boundaryWithAdjacentBlocks.P1-12: P1-12 owns inverse equal-groups relation semantics; P1-07 does not mint word-problem relations.

requiredChecks: knowledgePointId is one of the two matrix-primary G3B-U01 P1-07 KPs
V1 runtime divisor is a one-digit integer from 2 through 9
2-digit items use 10..99 dividends and classify start place from tensDigit compared with divisor
3-digit items use 100..999 dividends and classify start place from hundredsDigit compared with divisor
reported quotient digit count is consistent with the classified start place
primary V1 items do not require quotient-zero placeholder reasoning
two-digit-divisor quotient-place evidence must not leak into V1 runtime without separately approved extension
no divisor estimation, remainder interpretation, word-problem relation, or new canonical KP is introduced
